data.source: Binance official public USD-M futures archive and funding-rate REST endpoint

definitions.funding: Latest published funding rate strictly before the candidate entry.
definitions.open_interest_growth: Latest published sum_open_interest_value strictly before entry divided by its value 24 hours earlier minus one.
definitions.thresholds: Percentiles use only values from the previous 90 completed UTC days.
definitions.crowded_long: Funding and 24-hour open-interest growth are both positive and at or above the same frozen trailing percentile.

notes: The two percentile-and-size pairs are frozen and tested separately. Missing or not-yet-seasoned futures observations default to the normal $100 size. August-September 2026 is diagnostic only.
